headline.text: L2 ML2 demolder jammed repeatedly through the night — *8 separate stoppages* between 16:16 and morning shift handoff.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 had a foreign material event at 23:53 when a matrix screw head and nut went missing — one piece recovered by x-ray, 4 pallets on hold for re-screen. Matrix 6 went down at 01:32 with no bucket display, and Kitchen A condensed milk seal is leaking 4 pounds per batch. Sollich 3 metal detector belt kept stopping after 22:57. Sollich 4 discovered a torn perforated belt during cleaning.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 demolder problems dominated the window — 8 stops between 16:16 and shift end for mold jams and belt tracking. Line slowed to 12 MPM at 01:28 to get consistent BBD print. VFFS had scale issues at 02:29, partially cleared but still seeing blow-offs and double bags at 03:47. ML3 ran clean.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 Cavanna flow wrap cut 3.4% of product at 10:12, went down at 10:53 for jaw adjustment, cleared by 12:04. Bosch E04 film error resolved at 16:57 but returned at 23:07. Sensor B100A failing to reject at 08:54. Temper dropped to -0.6 at 01:05, corrected by 02:05. Truffle line conveyor stuck at 07:04, cleared 07:09. Matrix ran incorrect lot code on BEQ at 02:42.

notes.text: Third shift finished early (4 hours) for company party on 08/08 per Alan Greer.
Sollich 2 will replace Kitchen A milk seal during upcoming BET 23g to PRS 12g changeover.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 caramel texture wrong after pause
resolved.summary: After latest 5-minute pause caramel started coming out too soft, gap tool reading incorrect, no settings changed in kitchen.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:29 — gap closed from 2.8 to below 2.5, caramel sticking to bottom drum and making decent bed, running again (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: ML2 mold jam at demolder
resolved.summary: Mold jammed entering demolder belt during 14 MPM trial run.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:09 — line back up (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: VFFS seal bar out of alignment
resolved.summary: Seal bar needed adjustment, line down for maintenance work.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:17 — seal bar adjusted, line running (VFFS).

resolved.title: Matrix bucket 2 scale not registering
resolved.summary: Bucket 2 on MF Matrix stopped working, not reading pouches for filling.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:28 — Nathan Ruiz completed span calibration on bucket and adjusted pouch infeed sensor.

resolved.title: Cavanna jaw pressure causing open flow wrap seals
resolved.summary: Flow wrap was cutting during sealing, causing 3.4% of pieces to open in inspection — chocolate buildup on infeed and jaw pressure needed adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:04 — Chris G. adjusted jaws, post-adjustment inspection found no open product or cut film; 14:09 QA confirmed 100% properly sealed (Isis Oses).

resolved.title: Bosch E04 film error recurring on ML1
resolved.summary: E04 film following errors accumulated through first shift — 12 errors by 15:41, caused by locking bar mechanism not secured.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:57 — Efrain locked bar in place instead of threading up; Bojana observed 30 minutes with no errors (Bojana Kantar).

resolved.title: Bosch infeed belt north side not working
resolved.summary: Infeed belt on Bosch ML1 stopped running, blocking flow to wrapper.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:09 — maintenance removed belt, repaired off-line, reinstalled and belt running correctly.

resolved.title: ML1 temper dropped below spec
resolved.summary: Temper reading came in at -0.6, line pulled product and adjusted crystallization temperature by 0.1 from 78.7 to 78.8.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:05 — hopper emptied at 01:15, line restarted at 01:25, temper read 0.3 and line running good (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: Truffle line conveyor belt under cutter stuck
resolved.summary: Belt feeding product under the cutter blade was not moving, blocking production start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:09 — Nathan tensioned the conveyor and belt is moving (Itzel Chavez).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 matrix screw and nut foreign material event
needs_attention.summary: Matrix 7 missing rubber screw head with metal plate and nut at 23:53 — one piece found in x-ray reject at 11:15 PM, nut still missing, 4 finished pallets on hold for re-screen.
needs_attention.status: X-ray confirmed detection capability with test nut, all non-functional knobs removed from matrix 6/7/8 as precaution, investigation timeline documented at 01:28 by Ebrima Dibba, pallets awaiting re-screen.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 perforated belt torn on edge
needs_attention.summary: Blue perforated belt center tearing discovered during cleaning — side of belt broken, no foreign material found in product, need replacement before start.
needs_attention.status: Belt damage identified at 23:29, replacement needed before tomorrow's start per Conner Boyd.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 metal detector belt keeps stopping
needs_attention.summary: Conveyor belt after metal detector experiencing issue and stopping repeatedly, maintenance on-site at 22:57.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance inspecting as of 23:47, no resolution reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 Matrix 6 no bucket display
needs_attention.summary: Matrix 6 stopped showing buckets at 01:32, not bagging, causing product accumulation while maintenance works issue.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on-site as of 01:32, no resolution reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 Target depositor not cleaned to spec
needs_attention.summary: Target depositor marked complete on quick view but pistachio dust present throughout equipment, needs re-clean and allergen test.
needs_attention.status: Re-cleaned by third shift, still needs QA inspection and allergen test as of 07:08.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 Kitchen A condensed milk seal leaking
needs_attention.summary: Seal blown on condensed milk line in Kitchen A — 4 pounds of milk leaking into mixing tank A every batch made in Kitchen B.
needs_attention.status: Not urgent per discussion with Jody Howse, plan to replace during upcoming BET 23g to PRS 12g changeover.

needs_attention.title: ML2 demolder jams recurring through 2nd and 3rd shift
needs_attention.summary: Demolder jammed 8 separate times between 16:16 and morning handoff — mold flipping off belt, twisting disabled at 15:02 as workaround, belt tracking issues, turning arm pressure increased.
needs_attention.status: Raymond Fleming increased turning arm pressure and adjusted swing at 22:14, Lance cleaned and tracked belt, jams continued through night, last reported stop at 22:19 third shift.

needs_attention.title: VFFS scale and blow-off issues partially cleared
needs_attention.summary: Kick-offs and consistent zero error at 02:29, one side of scale not locked in — less blow-offs after fix but still seeing some plus double bags from product stuck in jaws.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance corrected unlocked scale side at 03:47, improved but Zack reports product still getting stuck between jaws causing doubles, plan to discuss with 1st shift.

needs_attention.title: ML2 twins belt and laser printer work in progress
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 06:26 for twins belt adjustment, came back at 07:11, then stopped again at 07:14 for laser printer trial.
needs_attention.status: Line down at window close, maintenance trying laser printer configuration.

needs_attention.title: ML2 slowed to 12 MPM for BBD print quality
needs_attention.summary: Could not get consistent best-by-date print on layflat bar at higher speed, line slowed from 14 MPM to 12 MPM.
needs_attention.status: Running at reduced speed as of 01:28, seeing better print results at 12 MPM.

needs_attention.title: ML1 sensor B100A failing to reject product
needs_attention.summary: Sensor B100A not rejecting defective product, causing jams on rail and large remelt volume.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 08:54, no follow-up or resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 Bosch E04 error returned on third shift
needs_attention.summary: E04 film error happening almost every other minute starting 23:07 when Nathan and Alan came to show Raoul the locking arm — same issue that was resolved earlier at 16:57.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 23:07, no resolution reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix BEQ ran with wrong lot code
needs_attention.summary: BEQ pouches ran with lot code 26114 when correct lot is 26211 — may be just one pallet affected.
needs_attention.status: Identified at 02:42, no resolution or disposition reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line first batch soft and stuck in cutter
needs_attention.summary: First batch of product coming out very soft at start of production, got stuck in cut blade.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 07:06, conveyor tensioned and moving but no update on soft product issue by window close.
